texts.zh: 虽对大多数生物都有毒性，[From.GetName]的高气压大气层也同样存在生机勃勃的生态环境。这里的生物用氨水而不是水来作为溶剂，并因此发展出了与其他地区截然不同的生态特征。对它们的研究会极大的丰富对异星生物学的了解。
texts.en: Although toxic to most forms of known life, [From.GetName] supports a thriving ecology within the high pressure of its atmosphere. Life here uses ammonia instead of water as a solvent, and has developed in ways that differ significantly from previously established ecological models. Its study would greatly benefit our knowledge of xeno biology.
